headline: M8 hex bolt shipment 6 days behind schedule, line stoppage risk at Chakan plant

breakdown.label: Idle assembly line cost
breakdown.basis: 6 days of Chakan line-3 downtime at historical ₹20L/day idle cost

breakdown.label: Expedited air freight surcharge
breakdown.basis: Quoted air-freight premium over the original sea-freight booking

breakdown.label: Contractual delay penalty (downstream OEM)
breakdown.basis: 0.5% per day penalty clause in OEM supply contract, capped at 5 days

diagnosis.narrative: Carrier's truck suffered an axle failure on NH48 near Lonavala; replacement vehicle dispatch was delayed by monsoon traffic restrictions.
evidence: GPS ping gap of 14 hours on carrier tracking API
Carrier support ticket #CT-88213 confirms axle failure
Weather advisory: NH48 heavy-vehicle restriction 05:00-11:00 IST

negotiation.transcript_summary: Vendor agreed to expedite to 2-day lead time and hold pricing within guardrail after volume commitment for next quarter.

timeline.note: Delivery delay signal raised from carrier tracking gap
Root cause identified as transport breakdown
Alternate vendor candidates matched and verified
Escalated to plant manager for approval
Voice negotiation started with Kohinoor Precision

headline: TTM forecast flags 18% cold-rolled steel price spike ahead of next PO cycle

breakdown.label: Projected cost increase on Q3 steel order
breakdown.basis: 18% forecast price delta applied to committed Q3 order volume of 40 tonnes

breakdown.label: Hedging / early-lock premium
breakdown.basis: Estimated premium to lock current pricing before the forecast breach date

diagnosis.narrative: Vendor's regional supplier base is passing through a raw-ore cost increase; TTM model detected the leading indicator two weeks before spot price movement.
evidence: Granite TTM forecast breach probability 0.81 for SKU CRS-2MM
Vendor's last two invoices show 4% and 6% sequential price creep

timeline.note: TTM forecast breach signal raised for SKU CRS-2MM
Correlated with vendor invoice price creep
